content.text: In regions where platforms like PayPal and [[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-which-architecture-actually-16|COREMERCH guide to coremerch]].github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-explained-digital-creators-stripe-3|stripe]] are inaccessible, establishing a digital store can feel impossible. This guide addresses the infrastructure limitations faced by digital creators in countries like Nigeria or Venezuela. With COREMERCH's Stack 02, you can deploy a fully operational digital store on Cloudflare Pages within 48 hours, enabling automatic crypto [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-explained-digital-creators-3|Payment Options]]s without reliance on conventional payment processors.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Stack 01 — the Sovereign Starter Stack — uses GitHub Pages for storefront hosting, Google Apps Script as the backend Web App, Google Sheets as the order database, Google Drive for product file storage, and Gmail for delivery email. The entire stack costs nothing per month. Google Apps Script runs in response to webhook events from NOWPayments, validates the payment, logs the order to Google Sheets, generates a receipt, and sends a Gmail delivery email with a Google Drive shared link. The daily limits on the free tier are adequate for most creators at the early and growth stages.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before beginning your deployment, ensure you have a GitHub account for hosting your digital store files. You will also need a Cloudflare account to set up your Pages and Workers. Familiarity with Google Apps Script will be beneficial for backend logic. Additionally, create an account with NOWPayments to handle your crypto transactions seamlessly. Gather your digital products for easy integration during the setup process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by deploying your backend using Cloudflare Workers to handle requests. Next, configure your NOWPayments integration to facilitate crypto payments. Ensure your payment verification process is automated to enhance user experience. For product delivery, link your digital files to Cloudflare storage or a Google Drive account. Test each component to confirm that payments are processed correctly and files are delivered as expected.
Full ownership of your digital store means no platform dependency.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to go live. Publish your Cloudflare Pages and ensure your domain is correctly pointing to your Cloudflare account. Test the purchasing process by making a small transaction with a cryptocurrency to verify that the payment is processed, and the product is delivered. Monitor the transaction in the NOWPayments dashboard to confirm successful order management.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your digital store operational, focus on scaling your offerings. Add more products to your store by uploading files and updating your inventory management system. Consider implementing marketing strategies to drive traffic to your store. Use analytics tools to evaluate customer engagement and optimize your workflow based on performance metrics. As your store grows, explore the Edge Commerce Stack to further enhance your capabilities.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Instant product delivery enhances customer satisfaction.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators at the store setup stage comparing Stack 01 and Stack 02 are typically choosing between building it themselves with the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 — which covers both stacks in complete detail with full source code — or having COREMERCH deploy the complete Edge Stack under their accounts with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?
Utilize Cloudflare Pages for hosting and integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This setup allows you to avoid traditional payment methods and ensures you have full control over your store.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?
Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages and Apps Script, while Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase. Stack 02 is deployed in 48 hours and includes more robust features for scaling.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?
Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are excellent choices for hosting a digital store. They provide the necessary infrastructure for deploying your products with automatic payment processing.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to choose the most popular options for your customers, enhancing payment flexibility and accessibility.
How long does it take to set up a digital store?
Setting up Stack 01 typically takes 4-6 hours when following the Sovereign Blueprint. Stack 02 can be deployed by COREMERCH within 48 hours, ensuring quick access to your digital store.
